jobs_results.title: Marketing & Operations Analytics Manager
jobs_results.description: Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com. About This Opportunity Risepoint partners with leading universities to expand access to high-quality online education, and Partner Strategy & Analytics team sits at the center of how those partnerships grow and perform. We're looking for a Marketing & Operations Analytics Manager who can turn complex, full-funnel partner data — from lead generation through yield — into the strategic narrative that shapes how Risepoint invests in and grows its portfolio of partner institutions. This role is built for someone who thrives at the intersection of rigorous analysis and cross-functional leadership. You'll own analytical workstreams end-to-end, from framing the right question to delivering the insight that moves a decision, while partnering closely with Integrated Marketing, Channel Marketing, Partner Management, and Operations teams. You'll be expected to spot the data quality issue before it becomes a stakeholder problem, build the pipelines that make partner performance monitoring reliable, and use AI-assisted tools like Claude and Databricks Genie to work faster without ever outsourcing your judgment. As the team grows, you'll also start building and coaching the analysts around you — this is a role with real room to grow into people leadership. If you want a seat where your analysis directly informs how a national portfolio of university partnerships is managed and grown, this is that seat. The Impact You Will Make You'll be the analytical backbone behind partner growth strategy. Your work on enrollment funnel performance — lead gen through yield — will directly shape the conversations and decisions that determine how Risepoint supports long-term partner growth. You'll protect the integrity of the data leadership relies on. By catching errors, discontinuities, and reconciliation gaps before they surface downstream, you'll build a level of trust in the numbers that lets stakeholders move faster and with more confidence. You'll build infrastructure that outlasts any single analysis. The pipelines and reporting workflows you design — in partnership with BI and data engineering — will become the foundation partner performance monitoring runs on well beyond your own day-to-day work. You'll set the pace for how the team works. By embedding tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into daily practice, you'll help define what an AI-first analytical function actually looks like at Risepoint — faster analysis, sharper communication, same rigor. You'll turn data into decisions. Through the KPIs you establish and the insights you translate into clear recommendations, you'll give executives and department heads a direct line from performance data to action. You'll grow the people around you. As the team expands, your coaching and project leadership will shape how new analysts think about partner data — building capability that compounds over time, not just output for the moment. How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life What You Will Do Cross-Functional Initiative Leadership: Drive and coordinate multi-stakeholder analytical initiatives across departmental boundaries, serving as a thought partner and initiative lead for Integrated Marketing, Channel Marketing, Partner Management Team, and other operations teams; own workstreams end-to-end from problem framing through insight delivery with minimal direction. Strategic Data-Driven Analysis: Handle highly detailed and complex partner performance data across the full enrollment funnel, from lead generation through yield, and facilitate internal stakeholder conversations that build strategies supporting long-term partner growth. Data Quality and Diagnostic Rigor: Proactively surface errors, discontinuities, and reconciliation gaps in partner data before they reach stakeholders, approaching each inconsistency as a signal worth tracing to its source rather than an edge case to dismiss. Analytical Infrastructure: Build and maintain the analytical pipelines and reporting workflows that underpin partner performance monitoring, collaborating with BI and data engineering teams to ensure data access, consistency, and appropriate governance AI-Assisted Productivity: Contribute to Risepoint's AI-first analytical practices by incorporating tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into day-to-day workflows to accelerate analysis and communication; AI is a productivity tool here, not a replacement for analytical judgment, and the expectation is full ownership of and accountability for the work product Strategic Project Execution: Take a leading role in the end-to-end strategic initiative design, management, execution, and impact assessment, leveraging analytical rigor and strong stakeholder management skills, including effective engagement with senior leadership. Proactively identify opportunities for performance improvement through data lens and translate insights into actionable initiatives to earn buy-ins from stakeholders. Performance Measurement: Establish and monitor key performance indicators to track the effectiveness of partner programs and analytical initiatives; surface actionable opportunities from performance data and translate them into recommendations leadership can act on Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate findings and insights to diverse stakeholders, including executives, department heads, and operational teams, through compelling presentations, structured briefings, and data visualizations that connect technical analysis to strategic People Management: Build a strong team with other team members some are expected to report to the Manager eventually by coaching, instructing, and drive projects as a team What Success Looks Like Analytical Rigor and Intellectual Curiosity: The ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis independently, pressure-test your own findings, and approach data inconsistencies as questions worth answering. Communication and Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate complex technical findings into strategic recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, including those with no data background, and to drive alignment without direct authority Cross-Functional Mindset: Collaborative instinct and comfort operating across teams; you function as a connector between data infrastructure and business strategy, and you bring a service orientation to stakeholder relationships Structured Thinking Under Ambiguity: You bring frameworks to unstructured problems, communicate your reasoning transparently, and know when to move forward with imperfect information versus when to escalate uncertainty. Attention to Detail: Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain analytical accuracy under time pressure; you validate before you publish and catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders. How Impact Will be Measured Partner performance improvement is the ultimate impact measurement. Partner Strategy & Analytics team strives to impact partners by supporting internal stakeholders with data-driven strategic insights and recommendations Trust thought partnership with internal leaders is another key success indicator as a Manager of Strategy & Analytics Experience That Matters Most 5+ years’ experience in an analytical or strategy leadership role (strategy, business analytics, business operations, corporate finance, business transformation) and/or in a professional services organization (consulting, private equity, investment banking) Strong proficiency in Databricks and advanced SQL, including CTE structuring, query performance optimization, and fundamental window functions, with foundational knowledge of data governance and data engineering principles. Familiarity with AI productivity tools like Claude and Databricks Genie, prompt engineering, and natural language query interfaces Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query M for data transformation workflows and DAX for calculated measures. Working experience with business intelligence and data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis and deliver data-driven insights with strong analytical and problem-solving skills Bachelor’s degree with proven record of achievement and quantitative proficiency Experience That’s Great to Have Proven track record in using Databricks, SQL, AI tools and data analysis to clean data, extract insights, and communicate takeaways to leadership in a professional setting Agile workstyle to meet evolving business needs in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment that Master's degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science is a plus. Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce. Reliable. Empowered. Adaptable. Customer-centric. Heart. These are some of the words that describe Risepoint employees. We have spent the past nearly 20 years helping universities grow by expanding access to affordable, life-changing education for working adults. As an education technology company that provides trusted partnership and expertise to more than 125 universities and colleges, we primarily work with regional universities, helping them create online programs in critical areas such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. We are dedicated to increasing access to affordable education so that more students can improve their careers and their communities.

jobs_results.description:
Omniscient is an organic growth agency that builds revenue-focused organic growth systems for B2B software companies - optimized for both search engines and generative AI.




We pride ourselves on being lean, agile, and experimental. Our team thrives on R&D and innovation, always exploring the smartest ways to deliver exceptional results. We believe in a culture of building and shipping - whether it's client deliverables, new services, or internal tools that keep us ahead of the game.




If you're looking for a role where you'll tackle challenging problems, work with ambitious brands, and help shape the future of organic growth, let's talk.




Learn about the principles that drive how we work and build a company.

About this role




You own the evidence behind our clients' growth decisions.




Our clients are investing serious money in AI search, SEO, and organic growth programs, and their executives are now asking: how does all of this tie back to signups, pipeline, and revenue?




Your job is to answer that question credibly, with clean and correctly wired data. You'll run analytics audits and implementations across our book, including enterprise accounts on Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Cloud.




You'll support our team's experiments, some of them conventional CRO tests and some of them brand new - like measuring whether adding FAQ content to a landing page moves citation share in LLM results.




This role is our first dedicated analytics hire. You will report to our CCO and operate as a center of excellence for the agency, meaning that prioritization is a key part of the job. If you like operating autonomously to find the story in the data and explain it to teammates and clients, this job is for you.




We're a fully remote team. We require work hours to overlap +/- 3 hours with US Eastern Time, since you'll be working directly with US-based client stakeholders.



Your responsibilities





 Own analytics audits and implementation. Assess client tracking setups across web and product analytics, identify gaps in data quality, taxonomy, and measurement, and fix them yourself. This includes hands-on configuration of tracking, tagging, and events in Adobe Analytics, CJA, GA4, and product analytics tools, as well as the data layer and tag management architecture underneath.
 Build the measurement layer that connects organic and AI search to revenue. Make sure things are wired up correctly, integrate data across sources, and build the attribution view that lets client execs see how SEO, AI visibility, content, and paid contribute to business outcomes.
 Run advanced analysis and segmentation. Deepen our reporting so we can answer why metrics are moving, including funnels, cohorts, behavioral segments, and SQL when the dashboard cannot get you there. You don't wait on someone else to pull the data.
 Enrich our client reporting. Design a useful reporting approach, document it as standard, and train strategists and account managers to run it without you. Success here means the process outlives your involvement.
 Build BI reporting and dashboards clients actually use. In the tools each client already relies on, built so stakeholders bookmark them and share them internally.
 Be the senior data partner on our largest accounts. You'll carry the measurement relationship on our enterprise engagements, present findings to client executives, hold your own in QBRs and strategy conversations, and create the connective tissue between our day-to-day work and a client's strategic goals.
 Support experimentation design and analysis. With our team, run conventional CRO and landing page tests, and help us invent AEO experimentation. You'll have a chance to define hypotheses, measurement approaches, and the read of the data.
 Enable client-side teams. Some of our largest accounts want us to level up their internal teams, not just deliver to them. If sold, you'll run assessments, workshops, and training that make their people better at measurement.
 Help define what we can credibly sell. Partner with leadership on how we scope analytics, CRO, and experimentation services.




Who you are



 You've worked hands-on in an enterprise Adobe environment. Adobe Analytics is required, and you've used Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Experience Platform alongside it. We mean production experience on a large, messy implementation, not a certification. Dreamdata and HockeyStack experience is a bonus.
 You've also worked with GA4 or comparable web analytics platforms, and with product analytics tools like Amplitude.
 You write SQL comfortably and can query, join, and shape data across sources to answer questions a dashboard can't.
 You can run an analytics audit end to end: find the gaps, prioritize them, and fix the implementation yourself.
 You can hold your own with a client's engineering team. You know what you're asking for when you request a data layer change; you can read an existing implementation, and you can scope work with the people who will ship it.
 You think in segments and cohorts, not just aggregates, and you know when an average is hiding the real story.
 You're a careful, meticulous reader of both data and instructions (the passcode is measurewhatmatters2026).
 You can explain a finding to a client's VP as clearly as you'd explain it to a fellow analyst, and you're comfortable being challenged on it.
 Data visualization skills are a strong plus. You know how to make a chart do the explaining.
 Experience in AEO, SEO, or organic growth marketing is a plus. Genuine curiosity about how AI search works is close to required, because a lot of this measurement problem has not been solved yet.
 You're not an asshole. We spend a lot of our days engaging with team members and clients. There's no room for assholes. You're friendly, eager to jump in and take ownership, and love to work as a team to be successful.




Why you should work with us




We're here to help you do great work and grow personally and professionally.



 A function to build: You're our first dedicated analytics hire. You'll set the standard, and if this works the way we think it will, you'll help us decide who to add next.
 Real impact: Your analysis directly shapes what clients decide to do next, and what we decide to build as a business. You're not producing reports that sit in a folder.
 Shiny new problems: Measuring AI search performance is an unsolved problem. You'd be helping define how it gets done, not applying a playbook someone else wrote.
 Autonomy and ownership: You own the audits, the implementation, the experiments, and the insight, end to end.
 Variety: You'll work across many clients, industries, and analytics stacks, including enterprise Adobe environments, not one narrow system.
 Coaching: We'll coach you toward becoming world-class at your function, and you'll help us do the same for the rest of the team.
 Remote flexibility: We're a 100% remote company, so you can work from anywhere.
 Team trips: We take team trips each year to places like Austin, Mexico City, Costa Rica, and Belgrade to get some time together in person.




Benefits




We're fortunate to offer competitive salaries and benefits, and we strive to create an environment that allows you to do your best work, develop your skills, and grow your career.



 Health insurance: 90% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums paid for employees in the US
 401k with employer match: We'll match 100% of your contributions up to the first 3% of pay, then 50% of your contributions on the next 2% of pay.
 Profit share: Opportunity to participate in our quarterly profit share program after 1 year of employment.
 Unlimited vacation: We trust you to take care of your work and communicate when you need time off. We recommend taking a minimum of 14 days a year.
 Learning and development stipend: $2,000 to spend on professional development after 1 year of employment.
 Free books program: We'll cover the cost of a Kindle and 1 Kindle book a month.
 Networking stipend: $50 per month to spend on coffee or lunch for professional networking.
 100% remote flexibility: Work from wherever you want.



We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. Omniscient Digital is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify and whatever background you bring, please apply if the idea of this role excites you.




Omniscient Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We ensure equal opportunity, and all candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Job Description

Who We Are

Horizon Media, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. We are headquartered in New York City, with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto. A leader in driving business solutions for marketers, Horizon is known for its highly personal approach to client service. Renowned for its incredible culture, Horizon is consistently named to all the prestigious annual Best Places to Work lists published by Fortune, AdAge, Crain’s New York Business and Los Angeles Business Journal. Together we are building a place of belonging.

At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. We value YOU and believe that your authentic voice and unique perspective allows us to create a more rewarding culture, and experience, together.

Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow.

What You’ll Do

5%- Help build the team to develop clear and concise dashboarding that will deliver information in an intelligent and digestible manner.  5%- Work closely across the media planning and brand strategy teams to develop KPIs and reporting methodologies / approaches that match back to campaign and brand goals and to communicate that based on client needs. 5%- Must be able to peel through the layers of reported data, disregarding the unnecessary, and deliver analysis and insight in a constructive and concise manner both internal and external client constituents. 85%- Must be able to manage client expectations successfully throughout multiple engagement 

Who You Are

You will go toe to toe with the client’s analytics team, as well as senior leadership potentially including the CMO. You will need to have a thorough understanding of digital and linear/traditional metrics; both from a brand and direct response perspective as well as a track record of successfully building analytic approaches across a broad mix of clients.  A strong business acumen and superior client service skills are a must. Also a supporter and advocate of diversity, equity and inclusion.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Strong analytical skills are required, including the ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions, and summarize actionable recommendations and their forecasted outcomes/implications. Thought leadership on all aspects of digital advertising, digital media strategy and standard media measurement Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to convey and package technical findings in layman’s terms 

Preferred Skills & Experience

Prior experience building teams and managing, training and mentoring junior staff on all aspects of digital analytics / measurements and recommendations Expert knowledge of DoubleClick/DART, MediaMind, Omniture and Google Analytics Exposure to mobile, social, tablet measurement approaches as well as understanding of role of multi-touch attribution in media evaluation Proven track record identifying on-going opportunities to productize revenue generating analytic solutions and sell into internal and external clients Experience building customized multi-channel attribution models either internally built or leveraging leading platforms (VisualIQ, Adometry, Convertro, C3) Expertise in: Ad-servers and verification tools (i.e. Google Marketing Cloud, DoubleVerify) Demand Side Platforms (e.g. The Trade Desk) Site and app analytics (i.e. Google Analytics, Kochava) Social listening (e.g. Netbase) Data Management Platforms (e.g. Neustar) Research Vendors (i.e. Kantar, YouGov) Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau) Self-serve analytics platforms (e.g. Alteryx) Scripting languages and relevant packages (e.g. R & tidyr) Integrated development environments (e.g. RStudio) SQL to query relational databases Microsoft Excel and Powerpoint Market Mix Modeling Python Experience managing and coordinating efforts across various teams/offices Deep Sr. Level Relationships with qualitative digital metric companies preferred (Vizu, Dynamic Logic, ComScore, Dimestore, Symphony IRI) 

Certificates, Licenses and Registrations 

N/A

Physical Activity and Work Environment

N/A

Horizon Media is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Salary Range

$150,000.00 - $195,000.00

A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based on factors such as individual’s skill sets, experience, training, education, licensure/certifications, and qualifications for the role. As an organization, we take an aptitude and competency-based hiring approach. We provide a competitive total rewards package including a discretionary bonus and a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, company paid holidays and unlimited paid time off (PTO), mental health and wellness resources, pet insurance, childcare resources, identity theft insurance, fertility assistance programs, and fitness reimbursement.
